text.card: A red giant 3,604 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.84 solar masses and 15.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,750 K at its surface.
